doubtful.songTitle: (You Make Me Feel Like) A Natural Woman
doubtful.linePrev: 'Til your kiss helped me name it
stanza: Oh, when my soul was in the lost and found
You came along to claim it
I didn't know just what was wrong with me
'Til your kiss helped me name it
'Cause if I make you happy I don't need to do more

partner.line: Oh, when my soul was in the lost and found

doubtful.line: Why can't I free your doubtful mind
doubtful.lineNext: And melt your cold, cold heart?
stanza: I tried so hard, my dear
To show that you're my every dream
Yet you're afraid each thing I do
A memory from your lonesome past
Why can't I free your doubtful mind
And melt your cold, cold heart?

doubtful.songTitle: (You Make Me Feel Like) A Natural Woman
doubtful.linePrev: 'Til your kiss helped me name it
doubtful.line: Now I'm no longer doubtful of what I'm living for
doubtful.lineNext: And if I make you happy, I don't need to do more
stanza: Now I'm no longer doubtful of what I'm living for
